title: Demo Engineer
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

As Ashby’s first Demo Engineer, you’ll own the systems that make our demo environments reliable, current, and tailored - the infrastructure the entire go-to-market team leans on to show Ashby at its best. Today, AEs and SEs maintain and configure their own demo accounts by hand. Your job is to close that gap.

This is a net-new role. Right now, the work is split between ad hoc effort and a new set of disposable demo templates the Internal Platform team is building. You’ll own the layer on top of that foundation - customizing and extending those templates, generating realistic demo data, tailoring environments for specific verticals and new markets, and making sure every feature is demoable before it ships. Your work will be split roughly 70/30: about 70% owning, customizing, and extending the demo template system and the data and content inside it, and about 30% running demo readiness as a program - release readiness, documentation, and enablement so the GTM team always has current, credible demos to work with.

The best person for this job is genuinely hands-on technical - working with internal tools and configuration files, using APIs, and general data preparation - who gets energy from building leverage for a whole team rather than fixing one demo at a time.

- 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments.

- 🎥 You care deeply about demo quality. You understand what makes a product demo land, and you’re thoughtful about data realism and the narrative a demo needs to support.

- 🧠 You have strong product intuition and can learn a deeply configurable product quickly, understanding how the different pieces connect.

- 🔁 You have an iterative mindset. You like testing what works, refining over time, and improving based on what you learn from the field.

- 🧩 You’re a systems thinker who would rather standardize and automate than manually repeat the same setup.

- ⚡ You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy a 0→1 role where the infrastructure is still being built around you.

- 🤝 You partner well cross-functionally - with Engineering and with GTM - and can translate their needs into reliable systems.

- 💙 You have empathy for the go-to-market teams you support and the Talent Acquisition space they sell into.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

- 📊 You’ve built demo environments, demo data, or sandbox/trial environments at a SaaS company before.

- 🧰 You’ve written automation scripts or tooling to generate data or configure environments at scale.

- 🎬 You’ve built and maintained a library of reusable, templated environments or assets that others relied on.

- 🤝 You have experience with HR tech, ATS workflows, or recruiting operations.

EXAMPLES OF THINGS YOU’LL WORK ON:

- 🧱 Own the scaled demo system - customize and extend the demo environment infrastructure to support the GTM team.

- 🗂 Generate realistic demo data - standardize and automate how demo environments are populated to eliminate manual setup.

- 🎯 Build vertical- and market-specific demos - create tailored content for target verticals and additional languages as we move upmarket and expand internationally.

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The AI Engineering team at 9fin is building the next generation of AI capabilities that will power our products for years to come. We're looking for an Engineering Lead to lead the GenAI Platform team, building the shared foundations that enable product teams to develop and operate AI-powered products and agents.

Reporting to the Head of AI, you'll own the team's development, technical direction and delivery. You'll shape the platform strategy and roadmap, working with product and engineering teams to understand their needs and decide where shared capabilities will have the greatest impact.

You'll combine people leadership with strong engineering judgement, staying close to architecture and code while giving engineers the support and autonomy to do their best work.

Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Шукаємо Creative Marketing Manager в команду, де разом піднімаємо планку результатів. Якщо ти зараз працюєш в Marketing Designer і хочеш перейти в креативний маркетинг, відгукуйся, такі профілі ми теж розглядаємо.

ЩО РОБИТЬ ЦЮ РОЛЬ ОСОБЛИВОЮ

- Масштаб тестування: гіпотези запускаються системно на широкому міксі каналів.

- Рутина автоматизована: автобриф для постановки задач, шаблони і готова структура для варіацій, AI-стек для текстовок і ресерчу. Свої автоматизації можна викатити на всю команду.

- Команда топових експертів ринку: User Acquisition, дизайн, MarTech та аналітика працюють пліч-о-пліч, і прямі партнерства з Meta і Google.

- Два треки розвитку: поглиблення експертизи до Senior Creative Marketer або перехід у лідерську роль Creative Lead.

ВИКЛИКИ, ЯКІ ЧЕКАЮТЬ НА ЦІЙ РОЛІ

- Досліджувати ринок і конкурентів через спай-тули (Meta Ad Library, Adheart і тп) та формувати на основі цього креативні гіпотези.

- Оформлювати гіпотези у ТЗ для дизайнерів і писати текстовки: хедлайни, дескрипшени, UGC-сценарії.

- Запускати тести разом з User Acquisition менеджерами, аналізувати результати і робити висновки для наступної ітерації.

- Масштабувати креативи, що показали результат, і створювати частину креативів самостійно за допомогою автоматизації і шаблонів.

ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО

- 2+ роки досвіду у перформанс-маркетингу, зокрема повний цикл роботи з дизайнером - від постановки ТЗ і запуску до відповідальності за результат.

- Досвід роботи зі спай-тулами та аналізу конкурентів, інтерес до автоматизації процесів.

- Робота з метриками: вмієш аналізувати результати тестів та аргументувати рішення даними.

- Буде плюсом: базові навички Figma / Adobe, робота з рекламними кабінетами Meta / Google, англійська для написання текстовок.

ЩО ТИ ОТРИМАЄШ ДОДАТКОВО РАЗОМ З НАМИ

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: аналітика, продукт, маркетинг, розробка, фінанси і рекрутинг.

- Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

- Світлі та сучасні офіси в Києві й Варшаві, а також можливість повністю працювати віддалено.

- Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.

 

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

title: Campaign Creative, Product Marketing
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

*Open to hiring remote across North America - we also have offices in NYC, London, San Francisco, Paris and Seattle.

We’re looking for a Creative with a focus on campaigns for Product Marketing. This is not a growth role. It’s a hands-on campaign creative role for someone who makes the work themselves, with AI as their primary medium. You’ll own full-funnel launch campaigns for Runway’s products, features and research: launch films, key visuals, landing pages, lifecycle emails, onboarding flows and everything in between. You’ll report to the Creative Director of Product Marketing.

We’re open to creatives who lead with art direction or with copy. What matters is that you make the work yourself and can move across both. Your work will directly shape how people discover, understand and adopt what Runway builds. That means work with real taste that stops people mid-scroll, makes new research feel tangible, and turns curiosity into first use. You’ll also help build the workflows and automations that let a small team ship at the pace of the product. You’ll partner closely with product marketing, design, research, growth and product teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build full-funnel launch campaigns end to end: the idea, the script, the boards, the generation, the edit, the finish.

- Make launch films, key visuals and campaign systems that hold up next to the best brand work in the world.

- Turn research breakthroughs into work people outside the field can feel, not just read about.

- Extend each campaign across every surface (landing pages, social, email, in-product) without losing the idea.

- Work at the pace of the product: several launches at once, fast timelines, quality never optional.

- Build the machine behind the work. Turn what you make into reusable prompts, workflows and automated pipelines, so every campaign starts further ahead than the last.

- Treat every new model as new creative territory, and show the team what’s now possible before anyone asks.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 4+ years making creative at an agency, studio or brand, with real campaigns shipped for real clients.

- A portfolio that proves taste first. AI-generated or AI-assisted work should be central to it.

- Fluency with image and video models, plus the craft tools to finish (editing, compositing, design).

- Art direction instincts: casting, styling, light, composition, type and pacing.

- A strong lead discipline (art direction, motion/edit or copy) and comfort across the others.

- A builder’s mindset. You’ve chained tools together, automated the repetitive parts, or built workflows others use.

- The range to move from a cinematic launch film to a single perfect frame in the same week.

BONUS POINTS

- Experience launching creative tools, AI

title: Retention & Recovery Lead
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

The role

The Retention & Recovery Lead owns one pipeline that follows every merchant from the first sign they might leave, through retention, a well-run exit and collections, to write-off or debt sale.

Today we treat churn and collections as separate problems, and neither has a clear owner. In practice they are usually the same merchant at different points in time: a merchant who goes quiet in March becomes, by June, an unpaid fee, a terminal still in the field and a balance nobody is chasing. Collections activity also sits in pockets across the business, from unpaid subscriptions and fees, negative balances and chargebacks to terminal recovery, dissolved companies and fraud losses. As our credit products grow, so will the need.

You’ll bring all of this together under one strategy, one queue and one set of metrics. We want someone who knows collections and its pain points, and who approaches the whole lifecycle with a product and design mindset: redesigning journeys end to end, and deciding where AI and automation belong and where people add the most value. You’ll start hands-on and build a small credit control team as the capability grows.

What you’ll do

- Own the retention-to-recovery pipeline end to end, from the first churn signal to write-off or debt sale, running from one prioritised queue with one set of definitions.

- Work with our data team to build and run an AI retention engine that identifies merchants heading towards churn, recommends the next best action for each and puts them in a queue to be worked. Prove what works with holdout groups, and do more of it.

WHO WE ARE

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

THE ROLE & YOUR IMPACT

We need a Principal Controls Engineer who owns the math behind putting a laser on a drone and keeping it there.

You'll own beam control and tracking as a theory domain across the whole system: the nested coarse and fine pointing architecture, the estimators that fuse radar cues, EO/IR track and inertial data, the jitter and latency budgets, and the analysis that says what the system can and cannot hit before we drive to the range to find out. You'll partner with the perception, optics and mechanical leads on architecture and roadmap, and you'll be the senior technical voice on controls decisions inside the company.

You'll derive the loop, run it in our in-house simulator, and have it on the hardware in days, not weeks. Then you'll stand on our outdoor range, control and refine laser positioning yourself, and watch it hold microradian precision on a maneuvering drone.

- Control architecture for the beam director: coarse gimbal and fine steering mirror loop structure, bandwidth allocation, multi-rate design, and the handoff between stages

- The pointing error budget and the field result: jitter, bias, latency and atmospheric terms allocated across the system, then microradian pointing precision achieved and held on our outdoor range against dynamic, real-world targets through hands-on experimentation and deployment

- Plant modeling and system identification: frequency-domain and time-domain ID of gimbal, mirror and structure, hardware-in-the-loop validation, and the models our in-house simulators run on

- Technical review and risk: catching what others miss in controls, estimation and sensor integration across the system

- Mentorship by example. Engineers learn from watching you work, not from being managed by you
